title: Incorrect result of window function, maybe related to OR-to-IN collection
bug_query: SELECT 'source_window' AS case_name, rowid, a, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY a COLLATE nocase, rowid) AS rn FROM t INDEXED BY t_a WHERE a='a' COLLATE nocase OR a='b' COLLATE nocase ORDER BY a COLLATE nocase, rowid;
expected: Both rows: (1,'A',1) and (2,'b',2), as the equivalent no-window query returns
actual: Only one row: (2,'b',1); the 'A' row is missing

title: bug: ordered correlated scalar subquery mixing integer and text values gives wrong result
bug_query: SELECT (SELECT s.c1 FROM t3 s WHERE a.k = s.c1 ORDER BY s.c1 LIMIT 1) FROM t0 a;
expected: ' 1' (both rows pass the equality, ' 1' sorts first)

title: Vuln61-42: CSV Virtual Table csvtabOpen 32-bit size_t Integer Overflow in nByte Allocation Causes Heap OOB
expected: Parse error 'csv: too many columns' or SQLITE_NOMEM, as on 64-bit builds
actual: 32-bit size_t wrap; AddressSanitizer SEGV (heap OOB read) in csvtabNext at ext/misc/csv.c:743

title: Incorrect result of max() on json_each
repro_sql:
WITH
  a(z) AS (SELECT replace(printf('%5c',' '), ' ', 'z')),
  b(z) AS (SELECT replace(printf('%5c',' '), ' ', 'a')),
  t(json,root_arg) AS (
    SELECT '{"'||a.z||'":[1]}', '$.'||a.z FROM a
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '{"'||b.z||'":[2]}', '$.'||b.z FROM b
  )
SELECT max(root), min(root), max(root||'')
FROM (
  SELECT j.root AS root
  FROM t, json_each(t.json, t.root_arg) AS j
);
bug_query: WITH a(z) AS (SELECT replace(printf('%5c',' '), ' ', 'z')), b(z) AS (SELECT replace(printf('%5c',' '), ' ', 'a')), t(json,root_arg) AS (SELECT '{"'||a.z||'":[1]}', '$.'||a.z FROM a UNION ALL SELECT '{"'||b.z||'":[2]}', '$.'||b.z FROM b) SELECT max(root), min(root), max(root||'') FROM (SELECT j.root AS root FROM t, json_each(t.json, t.root_arg) AS j);
expected: max(root) should be $.zzzzz (as max(root||'') is)

title: FTS5: snippet(), highlight() and fts5_get_locale() truncate the column argument to 32 bits

expected: Error: column index out of range, as for snippet(ft, 3, ...)
actual: CCC [xx] - the text of column 2 of a 3-column table

title: SQLite: redundant IS NOT NULL after BETWEEN recomputes an expensive expression
expected: One hex() evaluation per row; comparable execution time to the plain BETWEEN query
actual: Two hex(1) Function opcodes; ~1.72x slower (97.4 ms vs 56.7 ms)

title: Vuln92-73: fuzzer Extension NULL Pointer Dereference on MATCH NULL
expected: NULL query term treated as an empty match, no crash
actual: ASAN SEGV on address 0x0 in strlen via fuzzerFilter (ext/misc/fuzzer.c:1006)

title: Vuln14: PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=OFF Zeroes Deferred FK Violation Counters Allowing COMMIT of Orphaned Rows
expected: COMMIT should fail with 'FOREIGN KEY constraint failed'
actual: COMMIT succeeds; orphaned row 1|999 remains and foreign_key_check reports it

title: DBVuln15: approximate_match virtual table truncates 64-bit distance< bound via sqlite3_value_int()

expected: abc|0, same as the unbounded and distance<10 queries
actual: No output rows (bound truncates to -1, every candidate rejected)

title: Unexpected results when comparing fts4aux.term with a numeric value

expected: 2 (term >= 5 evaluates to 1 for both rows when projected)

title: PTP - Side-effect sqlite_log() is treated as innocuous
expected: With trusted_schema=OFF, schema-derived use of sqlite_log() should be rejected
actual: The view executes sqlite_log() and leaks 'schema-leak-token' to the log callback

title: Geopoly accepts non-finite polygons and its RTree optimization misses rows
bug_query: SELECT 'optimized' AS path, coalesce(group_concat(rowid||':'||label,','),'EMPTY') AS rows_seen FROM g WHERE geopoly_overlap(_shape,geopoly_regular(0,0,1,4));
expected: Rows 1 and 2, as the forced full scan (unary +) returns
actual: Only row 1; the RTree optimization prunes the NaN-bounding-box row

title: SQLite uuid_str()/uuid_blob() TEXT Conversion OOM NULL Dereference DoS
expected: SQL NULL or an OOM error when the text conversion fails

title: delta_parse() memory leak
